# Monitor

`sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/monitors/{monitor_id_or_slug}/` |
| create | `POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/monitors/` |
| update | `PUT /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/monitors/{monitor_id_or_slug}/` |
| delete | `DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/monitors/{monitor_id_or_slug}/` |

References: `organizationRef` → Organization / ClusterOrganization.

Credentials: via organization.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Monitor
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    config:
      schedule: <schedule>
    name: <name>
    organizationRef:
      name: <name>
    project: <project>
```
